$comment: Copy to sentinel.config.json and adjust. Every field is optional; see README.md for the full reference.
$comment_offline: Set true for air-gapped runs. Disables OSV advisory lookups; the scan reports that dependency results are incomplete rather than returning an empty list.

semgrep.$comment_registry: Registry packs are downloaded at scan time, so enabling them makes results depend on network access and on the registry's current contents. Leave empty for reproducible, offline-capable scans. Example: ["p/javascript", "p/python"]
